28	## 1. The frozen carrier spellings (probe-verified)
29	
30	**(1a) The finite chart adaptation** — DAT-1's §3.2 cover normalization with regular
31	equations instead of units, in a **`Fin`-indexed** spelling:
32	
33	```
34	structure FinCoverData (C R π) : Type u :=      -- NOT BasicOpenCoverData (Type (u+1)!)
35	  m₀ m₁ : ℕ
36	  h₀ : Fin m₀ → Γ(C_R, V₀ᴿ)   h₁ : Fin m₁ → Γ(C_R, V₁ᴿ)   a₀ a₁ : …
37	  partition₀ : ∑ j, a₀ j * h₀ j = 1              partition₁ : …
38	-- index := Fin m₀ ⊕ Fin m₁ ; pieces := Sum.elim (basicOpen ∘ h₀) (basicOpen ∘ h₁)
39	
40	structure DivisorAdaptation (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations) extends FinCoverData :=
41	  eqn      : ∀ j : index, Γ(C_R, pieces j)                 -- the equations f_j
42	  pt       : index → relCurve C R                          -- refinement witness:
43	  piece_le : ∀ j, pieces j ≤ d.cover.opens (pt j)          --   each piece sits in a
44	  unit     : ∀ j, Γ(C_R, pieces j)ˣ                        --   member of d.cover and
45	  eqn_eq   : ∀ j, eqn j = unit j * res (d.eqn (pt j))      --   f_j = u_j · d-equation
46	```
47	
48	PROBE FINDING (drives the `Fin` decision): DAT-1's `BasicOpenCoverData` carries
49	`J₀ J₁ : Type u` fields, hence lives in `Type (u+1)` — fatal for a functor VALUE
50	(`DivFam` must be `Type u`, the PicEt vehicle smallness). `Fin`-indexing keeps
51	everything `Type u` (probe P1); DAT-1's coverage lemma
52	`le_iSup_basicOpen_of_sum_eq_one` fires verbatim on the `Fin` families. A converter
53	`toBasicOpenCoverData` (J₀ := Fin m₀ …) is a thin def if a consumer wants DAT-1's
54	datum shape. Regularity and overlap unit-ratios of the `eqn j` are DERIVED from
55	`eqn_eq` + `d.regular`/`d.ratioUnit` (lemmas, not fields — the rescale-proof pattern
56	of `DivisorClass.lean:413`).
57	
58	**(1b) The colength modules and the glued equalizer** (probe P2/P3; all under the
59	local instances of §0):
60	
61	```
62	colength j      := Γ(C_R, pieces j) ⧸ Ideal.span {eqn j}          -- an R-algebra
63	ovlIdeal i j    := Ideal.span {res⁻ˡ (eqn i), res⁻ʳ (eqn j)}      -- SYMMETRIC span
64	ovlColength i j := Γ(C_R, pieces i ⊓ pieces j) ⧸ ovlIdeal i j
65	toOvlLeft/Right : colength i/j →ₐ[R] ovlColength i j              -- Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ
66	chartProd := Π j, colength j        ovlProd := Π p : index × index, ovlColength p.1 p.2
67	deltaLeft/Right : chartProd →ₗ[R] ovlProd                         -- LinearMap.pi/proj
68	gluedSubmodule  := LinearMap.eqLocus deltaLeft deltaRight         -- W(d), the worksheet eq(∏⇉∏)
69	```
70	
71	Decisions recorded: (i) the overlap quotient is by the symmetric two-generator span —
72	no ideal-equality transport in the DEFINITION (that `span {res f_i} = span {res f_j}`
73	on overlaps, from the derived unit ratio, is a LEMMA used in proofs); (ii) restriction
74	enters as `relResAlgHom : Γ(V) →ₐ[R] Γ(W)` (`AlgHom.mk'` over
75	`overAlgebraMap_apply_res`) — one def, all quotient maps are `liftₐ/mkₐ` composites;
76	(iii) `chartProd/ovlProd` MUST be `abbrev`s — the opaque-def spelling makes the
77	`Pi.module` instances non-defeq to the custom ones and every `LinearMap.pi` statement
78	fails (probe finding, the FLV-§5.2-class hazard of worksheet risk 4, resolved);
79	(iv) `eqLocus` (not a hand-rolled subtype) — it is mathlib's `Flat/Equalizer.lean`
80	vocabulary, which gives DD-1b for free (§3).

82	**(1c) The certificate.** Prop-structure `DivisorAdaptation.IsCertified n`:

84	```
85	finite_colength     : ∀ j, Module.Finite R (colength j)            -- (c1)
86	projective_colength : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (colength j)        -- (c1)
87	finite_glued        : Module.Finite R Glued                        -- (c2)
88	projective_glued    : Module.Projective R Glued                    -- (c2)
89	rankAtStalk_glued   : ∀ p, Module.rankAtStalk Glued p = n          -- (c2), see below

92	```

113	**(1d) The certified family, setoid, and functor value** (probe P7):
114	
115	```
116	structure CertifiedDivisorFamily (n : ℕ) : Type u :=
117	  eqns : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations
118	  adaptation : DivisorAdaptation C R π eqns
119	  certified : adaptation.IsCertified n
120	
121	DivEq d₁ d₂ : Prop := ∃ (𝒲 : PointedCover) (h₁ : 𝒲 ≤ d₁.cover) (h₂ : 𝒲 ≤ d₂.cover),
122	  ∀ x, ∃ u : Γ(𝒲.opens x)ˣ, res (d₁.eqn x) = u * res (d₂.eqn x)
123	
124	DivFam n R := Quotient (setoid: F ≈ G ↔ DivEq F.eqns G.eqns)        -- Type u
125	```

/-! ## Local equations -/

/-- Local equations for an effective Cartier divisor on `X`, adapted to a pointed cover:
a section `eqn x` on each member `cover.opens x`, whose germ at every point of that member
is a nonzerodivisor (`regular`) and whose overlap ratios `eqn x / eqn y` are units
(`ratio_isUnit`). The class of the associated Čech cocycle of transition units is the
divisor class `𝒪(D)`, see `LocalEquations.picClass`. -/
structure LocalEquations (X : Scheme.{u}) : Type u where
  /-- The pointed cover on whose members the local equations live. -/
  cover : X.PointedCover
  /-- The local equation on the member `cover.opens x`. -/
  eqn : ∀ x, Γ(X, cover.opens x)
  /-- Each local equation is regular: its germ at every point of its member is a
  nonzerodivisor in the stalk. This is the primitive form of regularity; it implies the
  regularity of every restriction (`eqn_restrict_mem_nonZeroDivisors`). -/
  regular : ∀ (x y : X) (hy : y ∈ cover.opens x),
    (X.presheaf.germ (cover.opens x) y hy).hom (eqn x) ∈ nonZeroDivisors (X.presheaf.stalk y)
  /-- On the overlap `cover.opens x ⊓ cover.opens y` the two equations differ by a unit
  factor `eqn x = u · eqn y`, so that `𝒪(D)` is invertible. -/
  ratio_isUnit : ∀ x y, ∃ u : Γ(X, cover.opens x ⊓ cover.opens y)ˣ,
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op).hom (eqn x)
      = (u : Γ(X, cover.opens x ⊓ cover.opens y))
        * (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_right).op).hom (eqn y)

namespace LocalEquations

variable (d : X.LocalEquations)

/-- Section-level regularity: the restriction of `eqn x` to any sub-open `W ≤ cover.opens x`
is a nonzerodivisor in `Γ(X, W)`. Sections of a sheaf inject into the product of their
germs, so nonzerodivisibility of the germs (the field `regular`) propagates to every
restriction. -/
lemma eqn_restrict_mem_nonZeroDivisors (x : X) {W : X.Opens} (hW : W ≤ d.cover.opens x) :
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op).hom (d.eqn x) ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(X, W) := by
  rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_right]
  intro t ht
  apply TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext X.sheaf W t 0
  intro y hy
  rw [map_zero]
  have key : (X.presheaf.germ W y hy).hom t
      * (X.presheaf.germ W y hy).hom ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op).hom (d.eqn x)) = 0 := by
    rw [← map_mul, ht, map_zero]
  rw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply] at key
  exact (mul_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors_eq_zero_iff (d.regular x y (hW hy))).mp
    (by rw [mul_comm] at key; exact key)

    Nonempty (DivisorAdaptation C R π d) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ι₀, _, f₀, an₀, b₀, hsub₀, hpart₀⟩ :=
    (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R (fiberTwoCover π)).exists_finite_basicOpen_refinement d.cover
  obtain ⟨ι₁, _, f₁, an₁, b₁, hsub₁, hpart₁⟩ :=
    (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R (fiberTwoCover π)).exists_finite_basicOpen_refinement d.cover
  set e₀ : Fin (Fintype.card ι₀) ≃ ι₀ := (Fintype.equivFin ι₀).symm with he₀
  set e₁ : Fin (Fintype.card ι₁) ≃ ι₁ := (Fintype.equivFin ι₁).symm with he₁
  -- the `Fin`-indexed cover data
  set D : FinCoverData C R π :=
    { m₀ := Fintype.card ι₀
      m₁ := Fintype.card ι₁
      h₀ := fun j => f₀ (e₀ j)
      h₁ := fun j => f₁ (e₁ j)
      a₀ := fun j => b₀ (e₀ j)
      a₁ := fun j => b₁ (e₁ j)
